text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees work faster and better. Many companies also encourage human-AI collaboration, where people and machines solve problems together. However, these changes affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones will appear. Workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive. Overall, AI can make work easier, but it also requires people to adapt. Understanding both the benefits and challenges of AI is important for everyone in the modern workplace.
